Who we are

Plaeta is a study app for students in their final two years of school. It is run by [business name, ABN], Australia. You can contact us at hello@example.com.

The laws we follow

  • The Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and the Australian Privacy Principles, which set how personal information is collected, used, kept safe and corrected.
  • The Children's Online Privacy Code once it is registered by the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner, and any other children's privacy code that applies to us. We will update Plaeta and this policy to meet it.
  • The Online Safety Act 2021 (Cth), including the Basic Online Safety Expectations and the industry codes registered by the eSafety Commissioner.
  • The usage policies of the AI provider we use, including its rules for products used by people under 18.

Who can use Plaeta

  • Plaeta is made for students aged about 16 to 18. You must be at least 13 to have an account. We ask for your date of birth when you sign up and do not let anyone younger sign up.
  • If you are under 18, a parent or carer should read this policy and the terms with you.
  • During the free test phase, Plaeta is for testers aged 18 and over only (see below).

The free test phase

Before launch, Plaeta runs as a free test version. In this phase:

  • There are no accounts and no payments. Your subjects, notes and progress are saved in your own web browser on your own device. We do not receive them.
  • AI features use Google Gemini's free tier. By default, your requests pass through our server, which adds our shared trial key and sends them on to Google. We do not keep what you send. If you add your own Gemini key in the app's Settings instead, it is stored only in your browser, is never included in backups, and your requests go straight from your browser to Google.
  • Either way, what you send to the AI is handled by Google under its own terms. Google's terms for its free tier allow it to use that content to improve its products, so do not upload anything personal.
  • Because of Google's terms, the test version is for people aged 18 and over.

The rest of this policy describes Plaeta from launch, when accounts and plans open.

What we collect

  • Your account: email address, a password (stored only as a secure hash by our sign-in provider), date of birth, and an optional display name. We keep your date of birth to check your age.
  • What you add: your subjects, exam dates, syllabus files and topic lists, past papers you upload, your answers (typed or photographed), marks, feedback, flashcards and notes.
  • Your plan: which plan you are on and its billing dates. Card details go straight to our payment provider, Stripe. We never see or store your card number.
  • Usage: how many papers you uploaded this month and how much AI each request used, so we can apply your plan's limits.
  • Safety records: reports you send us, and a short log when our safety filter acts (what kind of thing it found and what it did, not the text you typed).

We do not collect your school, home address or phone number, and we ask you not to type them anywhere in the app.

Where it is kept

Your account and study data are stored with Supabase in its Australian region (Sydney), protected by database rules so each student can read only their own records. Uploaded files are kept in private storage that only your account can open. Payments are handled by Stripe. The app and this website are served by Cloudflare.

How long we keep it

  • Past papers you upload: the file, its page images and the question text are deleted automatically 60 days after upload. What stays is your own work: your answers, marks, feedback, flashcards and, for each question, a short label, its marks and its topic.
  • Your syllabus and topic list: kept while you use Plaeta, and deleted when you delete them or close your account.
  • Everything else: kept while your account is open. If you pause your plan, your data is kept. If you close your account, we delete your data within 30 days, except records the law requires us to keep, such as payment records.

Who sees it

Only you. Nothing you upload is shown to, shared with, or used to answer another student. We do not sell your information, show advertising, or use your work to train AI models. Our team looks at your data only to fix a problem you reported, or when the law requires it.

We use these service providers to run Plaeta, each only for its job: Supabase (accounts and storage), Stripe (payments), Cloudflare (hosting) and Anthropic (AI marking from launch).

How AI is used

Plaeta uses an AI system to read your papers, mark your answers, suggest flashcards and help plan your study. You are working with an AI system, not a person. Every mark, piece of feedback or suggestion made by AI is labelled in the app. AI can be wrong, so check its marks against your course's marking criteria and ask your teacher when unsure.

  • We never send your name, email, date of birth or other account details to the AI. Our filter also removes email addresses, phone numbers and street addresses from what you type before it reaches the AI.
  • The AI marks only against criteria you supplied and never changes a mark your teacher gave.
  • From launch, the AI provider is Anthropic. Requests go through our server, which adds safety instructions to every request. Anthropic does not use this data to train its models.

This website and cookies

This website does not use cookies, analytics or advertising trackers. Like any website, our host (Cloudflare) processes your IP address to deliver pages and protect against attacks. Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which also receives your IP address when you visit.

Keeping you safe

  • A safety filter checks what you type and what the AI sends back. It blocks sexual content, and if what you write suggests you may be in danger or thinking about hurting yourself, the app shows you where to get help.
  • The app shows short guidance on using it safely, on first use and in Settings.
  • You, or a parent or carer, can report a problem at any time.

Your choices and rights

  • See and download your data: Settings, Your data, Export my data.
  • Correct it: edit your details in Settings, or contact us.
  • Pause: pause your plan for up to 2 months and keep your data.
  • Cancel: one step in Settings. We offer you an export first.
  • Delete: close your account and we delete your data as described above.
  • Complain: contact us first. If you are not happy with our answer, you can complain to the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner at oaic.gov.au.

How to report a problem

In the app, go to Settings, Safety, Report a problem. You can report a wrong mark, something the AI said that upset you or seemed unsafe, or anything else. Parents and carers can email [safety contact email]. We aim to reply within 2 business days, and sooner for anything about someone's safety.

If anyone is in danger now, call 000. Kids Helpline (1800 55 1800) and Lifeline (13 11 14) are free and open any time.

Contact us

[Business name], [postal address], hello@example.com. Our privacy officer will reply within 30 days.

Changes to this policy

If we change this policy in a way that matters, we will tell you in the app before the change takes effect.

A study partner for high school. Made in Australia.
